standard_prerequisites.use: G_K' is dense open, in particular nonempty after base change.

standard_prerequisites.name: Jacobson rational points after large transcendental extension

core_obligations: Reduce by the when-scheme-after-base-change lemma to producing a K-rational point in the schematic locus.
Get a K-rational point of G_K' from the dense-open statement plus Jacobson rational points on the covering.
Move the arbitrary rational point g into G_K' by the group automorphism h |-> g(g')^{-1} h and note automorphisms preserve the schematic locus.
proof_roadmap: Schematic-locus density, rational-point production, and the group-action transitivity closing the argument.
difficulty_reason: The transitivity of the group action on rational points and its compatibility with the schematic locus are the substantive steps.
